newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Phnom Penh blasts injure opposition demonstrators.
newsitem.headline: Phnom Penh blasts injure opposition demonstrators.

text.p: Twenty people were injured on Sunday, some seriously, when three explosions rocked an opposition demonstration outside the Cambodian National Assembly, witnesses said.
They said some 150 people were taking part in a protest against the Cambodian judiciary organised by opposition figure Sam Rainsy when grenades apparently went off in the crowd.
The witnesses said the injured included food vendors but were mostly demonstrators from the Khmer Nation Party. Some were children and one woman had her legs blown off.
The blasts left marks on the road that appeared to be from grenades. Blood and scattered placards littered the ground.
Makeshift ambulances took away the injured.

The demonstration had been authorised by Phnom Penh municipal authorities and was the latest in a series by Rainsy on various issues ranging from the plight of garment workers to the arrest of his security chief.
